authorization_scope: Static preparation only. Root external decision and separately reviewed scientific/operational justification required. Existing terminal units are not reopened.
purpose: Concrete proposed A budget/diagnostic candidate for independent review; not selected for consumption. Adequate scientific recovery remains unmeasured.
hypothesis: Same aligned-spin pSEOBNRv4HM_PA IMR model for both synthetic datasets; DTau220 only free QNM deformation; DOmega220=DTau440=DOmega440=0.

mass_prior_normalization.description: Uniform rectangular m1 [35,110], m2 [20,80], conditioned on 0.2<=m2/m1<=1; normalized analytic inverse CDF. No likelihood rejection or evidence renormalization ambiguity.

data_rule: Read only exact pinned NPZ allow_pickle=False; reconstruct noise+signal and check all six hashes per job. No data finder, event ids, input override, observed strain, D posterior or GR posterior.

sampler.log_likelihood: bilby GravitationalWaveTransient.log_likelihood_ratio, Gaussian independent H1/L1; absolute noise-only normalization omitted equally in the same job; no cross-dataset Bayes-factor interpretation

stop_rules: Counter checked before every likelihood, including 256 live-point initialization; Dynesty maxcall additionally applied but not trusted as hard cap.

Abort job and campaign on EDOM, native failure, nonfinite likelihood, window-bound violation, unknown read/write, pin mismatch or uncaught process failure. Never map an invalid waveform to a prior rejection.
Graceful maxcall/wall/CPU exhaustion writes partial diagnostics and permits the second planned job; no restart/resume. Supervisor timeout/kill is uncertain partial and halts remaining job.
No extension of call/time/CPU/prior/grid/seed limits based on the observed pilot outcome.

convergence.numerical_stop: delta_logz<0.1 before final live points, non-flat live likelihood, below hard call cap, no error.
convergence.sampling_diagnostic: weighted ESS>=100 after final live points; ESS low is explicitly incomplete.
convergence.posterior_summary_rule: Expose weighted raw diagnostics and proposed dtau220 summaries; label numerical-only/weak-descriptive. Never auto-pass science, coverage or D.

cost.measured_reference: P0-P2 RUN_002: six native waveform generations for fixed cases, not PE benchmark.
cost.warning: Prior-dependent evaluation cost and likelihood overhead unmeasured. Proxy is neither budget guarantee nor a measured PE pilot.
report: classified failure_receipt: None, recognized domain exception, indeterminate source/native exception, temporal/budget/application events
cost.projection_rule: Report measured sums and rates only; no extrapolation to fourteen observed events as validated cost.

isolation.python_read_allowlist: Same exact 1162 runtime files and synthetic/source pins, plus the one hash-pinned installed ASD demanded by official H1/L1 factory. No directory wildcard. Qualification metadata are exact pinned inputs.
isolation.writes: Only exact new execution/job tree after hook; local reservation/receipts before hook. Not native syscall containment.
isolation.runtime_caveat: Fixed imports/pin verification precede hook. Python audit is not native syscall or OS security containment. -I -B limits environment/bytecode effects; no installation.
isolation.source_fresh_lal_dict: Preserved unchanged P0-P2 source makes lal.CreateDict per waveform and inserts all four deformation values.

allowed_status_claim: REAL static package and documentary comparisons; OPEN input integrity, candidate execution, posterior recovery/convergence, coverage and PE D.
revision: Proposal A only; limits and visible recovery summaries plus P3-01/P3-02 correction. No scientific source/prior/seed/data alteration, no v388 migration.

failure_receipt_policy.source_returned_none: Count independently; raw P0-P2 EDOM counter means None returns only and is named source_returned_none_counter_raw. Preserved EDOM_LOG.jsonl filename is not a total of all domain failures.
failure_receipt_policy.recognized_domain_exception: After a counted native attempt, errno EDOM or explicit Input domain error is classified as recognized, with type/message/parameters.
failure_receipt_policy.indeterminate_exception: Other exceptions after a native attempt remain indeterminate; a completed native-call counter alone does not prove the exception originated in C.
failure_receipt_policy.guards: Pre-native temporal/budget failures are separate; failures outside the source wrapper are application events.
failure_receipt_policy.no_double_count: Same exception object propagated from source to outer handler is recorded once. None guard raises and is likewise deduplicated. Counts across categories are not added as EDOM.
failure_receipt_policy.total_EDOM: domain_error_total=null; never infer a total from None or generic exceptions.
failure_receipt_policy.behavior: Keep catch_waveform_errors=False and propagate/abort. The wrapper binds to wf.frequency_domain_source_model, preserves signature/args/kwargs/fixed zeros, never returns -inf and does not retry.
failure_receipt_policy.budget_status: Use the recorded exception kind with its native-attempt stage; never reclassify a generic native timeout as a pre-native budget event. Native reservations occur before the unchanged native-call boundary; completion count is separate.

codec_preload.stage: After exact runtime checks and fixed imports, before installing the unchanged read hook.

qualified_initialization.dependency_scope: Exact default ASD is initialization-only; replaced by qualified analytic NPZ PSD before likelihood construction and rechecked afterward.
qualified_initialization.source_signature_policy: Unchanged adapter: generator constructor binds original synthetic_only220 and computes source_parameter_keys before the unchanged FailureAudit wrapper is assigned. No compatibility shim.
qualified_initialization.dynamic_boundary: Previous control evaluated no waveform/likelihood/sampler. This package has not been executed; initial sampling and prior-dependent waveform validity remain unmeasured.

consumption_justification.material_delta: Tenfold external likelihood/native-call caps, fourfold work/CPU limits; same sampler, prior, seed, source and frozen inputs; no empirical efficiency claim
consumption_justification.admission_guard: Exact future external decision must approve design A, envelope, weak diagnostic and exact access plan, pin contract/manifest and reference the operator approval; no force/bypass/fallback
consumption_justification.scientific_gain: Opportunity for additional constrained-prior exploration; adequate convergence/recovery not demonstrated; null/incomplete outcome remains possible

imports_qualification_evidence.use: Documentary evidence only, not imported object or permission to run PE

external_integrity: Historical expected pins only, raw targets not accessed in this preparation. Prior input rejection remains operative until exact separate permission.
case_id_semantics: GR_GAUSS and RB_GAUSS are descriptive slots only, not issued jobs/request IDs. Future execution UUID belongs solely to separately approved external decision.

numerical_criteria_retained.numerical_stop: delta_logz<0.1 before final live points, non-flat live likelihood, below hard call cap, no error.
numerical_criteria_retained.sampling_diagnostic: weighted ESS>=100 after final live points; ESS low is explicitly incomplete.
numerical_criteria_retained.posterior_summary_rule: Driver saves weighted raw diagnostics only; independent review interprets recovery. No automatic pass from truth inclusion.

stopping_and_acceptance.validity: No audit violation, unknown read, native/EDOM/None/nonfinite/temporal error, identity/pin mismatch; exact finalized receipts and certain process termination. Partial operational receipt is not scientific success.
stopping_and_acceptance.paired_numerical_acceptance: Both cases clean; delta_logz<0.1 before final live addition, non-flat likelihood, below external hard call cap, weighted ESS>=100 after addition; no global-mode certificate claimed.
stopping_and_acceptance.budget: External pre-evaluation counters include initial live points. No extensions. Cooperative budget partial only when clean and terminal identity certain.
stopping_and_acceptance.second_case: Preplanned RB after clean converged or clean incomplete GR; any failure or uncertainty stops remaining campaign. No threshold/seed/algorithm adaptation.

recovery.weighted_quantile_definition: inf{x:F_w(x)>=p}; normalize weights; sort by dtau220; no random resampling or interpolation
recovery.proposed_favorable_diagnostic: truth in [q05,q95] AND W90<2.52; only after clean numerical convergence and independent interpretation of shape/edges/limitations
recovery.strength: Weak case-specific compatibility plus contraction; not automatic scientific pass; near-prior width may still qualify weakly and must be reported
recovery.ESS_limit: ESS100 does not certify quantile accuracy or tails
recovery.if_not_met: RECOVERY_NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_THIS_REALIZATION, not physical falsification or coverage result
recovery.operator_decision_required_before_future: accept or alter this visible new diagnostic before execution

prior_consumption_justification_history.admission_guard: admit refuses before external input reads; enabling requires separately reviewed contract with status JUSTIFIED_BY_SEPARATE_REVIEW and explicit ROOT decision, never this preparation message
prior_consumption_justification_history.material_operational_delta: Persistent audit latch/checkpoints/FD journal, strict result acceptance, known pinned pre-hook including exact startup, root/manifest/decision/parent-process binding
prior_consumption_justification_history.limitation: Prior run not operationally accepted; no assertion future trajectory bitwise identical or that convergence is impossible. No evidence repairs improve posterior exploration.
prior_consumption_justification_history.preferred_next: Review separate documentary recovery design, not a repeat of the inherited envelope by default.

supervisor_policy.start: supervisor main before admission; per-case before output/CLAIM IO
supervisor_policy.cpu: RLIMIT_CPU counts total child process CPU; soft13200/hard13205, same limits also used at cooperative budget
supervisor_policy.finalization: check monotonic deadline after result/process receipt persistence, hashing and flushed terminal output; external nonzero or failure marker invalidates any provisional success
supervisor_policy.uncertain_termination: stop entire collection, no retry/remaining case
supervisor_policy.uncontrollable_limit: SIGKILL, process creation interruption before an owned Popen handle, host failure and uninterruptible OS I/O are not hard-contained; absence of conclusive external exit/receipts remains uncertain
supervisor_policy.logs: stdout/stderr file capture preserved; not described as a hard disk/output quota
supervisor_policy.posix_signal_mask: Parent defers SIGINT/SIGTERM around Popen→handle assignment. Child inherits their blocked mask; Popen.restore_signals does not restore it. Current cleanup intentionally uses unmaskable SIGKILL for the owned group. Child SIGALRM/SIGXCPU remain unblocked. No preexec_fn. Verified by source inspection only, not a real POSIX-process test.

configuration_32_semantics: CONFIG_SYNTHETIC.max_native_calls=32 belongs to frozen P0/P2 adapter metadata checked by validate_config. generator does not use it as P3 counter; unchanged. P3 external counters in driver and source_before_waveform enforce100000.
